name: CBF Extrapolate
description: Frame extrapolation for smoother rendering with automatic tuning.

auto-adjust.name: Automatic Tuning
auto-adjust.description: Automatically adjusts extrapolation strength based on FPS stability and frame pacing.

debug-extrapolation.name: Debug Extrapolation
debug-extrapolation.description: Logs extrapolation timing, reset skips, and automatic tuning decisions for debugging frame pacing issues.

render-extrapolation-scale.name: Render Extrapolation Scale
render-extrapolation-scale.description: Multiplies render-side extrapolation to make the effect more noticeable while staying clamp-limited.

render-extrapolation-min-frames.name: Render Extrapolation Min Frames
render-extrapolation-min-frames.description: Minimum render extrapolation amount in frames so small timing gaps still produce visible movement.
